title: Interview with Ben
summary: Kwame interviewed Ben, a pilot, in an informational interview.

qa_highlights.question: What role does the community play?
qa_highlights.answer: Volunteers found most of the bugs

qa_highlights.question: How did the project start?
qa_highlights.answer: The team noticed the sensors drifted every winter and nobody had measured it before

qa_highlights.question: What was your biggest early mistake?
qa_highlights.answer: They trusted the vendor numbers without checking them

qa_highlights.question: Why does this work matter to you?
qa_highlights.answer: Small errors add up over years and become wrong decisions

quotes.speaker: Ben
quotes.text: Without them we would still be guessing.

quotes.speaker: Ben
quotes.text: A tiny drift becomes a wrong decision.
